summary: Iteration 14 — verified daily-housekeeping notifications cleanup + Site Visit History card on Project Detail. 6 new pytests added, all 40 prior regression tests still green (46/46 in the active suite). Frontend rendering verified for both populated and empty project cases.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~4,518 lines — consider modularising (routers, services, schedulers) per the 700-line guideline; not blocking this iteration.

Older test_iteration4/5/6 files reference obsolete endpoints (/api/auth/status, /api/auth/set-password, /api/auth/verify, sqlite import, etc.) and fail wholesale; main agent should delete or rewrite those test files so the default pytest run is clean. The 40-test regression set used by iter11–14 (site_visits + iter11 + iter12) is the canonical green suite.

_cleanup_old_read_notifications relies on lexicographic string comparison against ISO-format created_at — this is correct for UTC ISO-8601 timestamps; if any record ever stores naive (no tz) or differently-formatted strings, those would NOT be considered for deletion. Worth a small data-shape guard or migration note.

Scheduler uses AsyncIOScheduler attached to the FastAPI event loop — good. _stop_housekeeping_scheduler is wired only into shutdown_db_client; if supervisor sends SIGKILL the scheduler thread is preempted (acceptable in this preview env).
